wolf add --type decision --title "Plan exp: step 3 without updated_at" --body "Gap: data/metrics.json (verified at commit 219de89, 2026-11-17) contains only {\"sources\":{\"api\":12,\"web\":8}} — no updated_at field, which plan step 3 assumes. User reported the gap and mandated continue. Decision: summary report omits updated_at and explicitly states it is absent in the source data; no value is fabricated; source data is not modified; accepted plan text stays unchanged. Rejected alternatives: deriving updated_at from file mtime (fabricates semantics), adding the field to data/metrics.json (mutating a source input)." --tags plan-exp,deviation
python3 -c "
import json
d = json.load(open('data/metrics.json'))
src = d.get('sources', {})
per = {k: v for k, v in src.items()}
print('per_source:', per)
print('total:', sum(per.values()))
print('has_updated_at:', 'updated_at' in d)
print('top_level_keys:', sorted(d.keys()))
"
